headline: Historical Site Access and Local Event Schedules
reservation: Access to individual historic sites like the O.K. Corral or the Bird Cage Theatre often requires separate admission fees purchased on-site. During special event weekends, local accommodations fill rapidly; consult official tourism boards for seasonal performance times and street closure updates.

days.title: The Historic District Core

stops.name: O.K. Corral
stops.detail: Visit the site of the 1881 gunfight featuring walk-through exhibits and live historical reenactments.

stops.name: Tombstone Courthouse State Historic Park
stops.detail: Explore the original 1882 courthouse containing artifacts and documentation of the town's mining and legal history.

days.note: Allen Street is a pedestrian-only zone during mid-day hours to accommodate visitors.

days.title: Mining Legacy and Burial Grounds

stops.name: Boothill Graveyard
stops.detail: Observe the final resting place of notable figures from the town's silver mining boom era.

stops.name: Good Enough Mine
stops.detail: Take an underground tour of the silver mine that originally spurred the development of the district.

days.driving: Allow 30 minutes for local transit; conditions vary
days.note: Underground tours may have height restrictions and require sturdy footwear for uneven surfaces.

days.title: Frontier Culture and Preservation

stops.name: Bird Cage Theatre
stops.detail: View the preserved interior of a 19th-century saloon and variety theater with original furnishings.

stops.name: Rose Tree Museum
stops.detail: See the world's largest rose bush and learn about the family histories of early Tombstone settlers.

days.note: Operating hours for private museums may vary seasonally; check local postings upon arrival.

intel.title: Public Lots
intel.text: Main parking is located on the periphery of the historic district near Toughnut Street. RV parking is restricted in the narrow center of the historic townsite.

intel.title: Network Reliability
intel.text: Cellular signal is generally stable within the town of Tombstone. Coverage may drop off quickly as you drive into the surrounding San Pedro Valley desert areas.

intel.title: Regional Services
intel.text: Fuel stations are located on the outskirts of Tombstone along Highway 80. Neighboring Benson and Sierra Vista offer more extensive automotive services.

intel.title: Desert Heat
intel.text: Summers involve extreme heat; historical walking tours are best conducted in the morning. October through April offers the most temperate conditions for outdoor activities.

intel.title: Historical Structures
intel.text: Many historic boardwalks and buildings have high thresholds or narrow entryways. The State Historic Park is the most modernized facility regarding physical access standards.

plan.arrival: Pick up a rental vehicle in Tucson and stock up on water and supplies before driving south on I-10 and Highway 80. Check-in at local inns usually begins in the late afternoon.
plan.vehicle: Standard passenger cars are ideal for the paved roads of Southern Arizona; check rental contracts if planning to explore unpaved ranch roads nearby.
plan.goldenHour: The Tombstone Courthouse offers a classic frontier silhouette against the sunset, though the best desert colors are found along the Highway 80 overlooks.
